# Love and Lemons

> > A plant-forward recipe blog featuring seasonal vegetarian and vegan cooking by Jeanine Donofrio and Jack.

Love and Lemons specializes in fresh, healthy recipes emphasizing vegetables, whole grains, and plant-based ingredients. The site offers approachable vegetarian and vegan dishes for everyday cooking, with a focus on seasonal produce and wholesome comfort food.

## Key Topics

- vegetarian recipes
- vegan cooking
- gluten-free options
- seasonal produce
- comfort food
- meal prep
- one-pot meals
- plant-based eating
- whole grains
- farmers market cooking
- healthy breakfast
- salad recipes
- soup recipes
- sweet potato dishes

## Main Dishes & Comfort Food

- [Sweet Potato Vegetarian Chili Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/sweet-potato-vegetarian-chili): Vegetarian sweet potato chili recipe - one-pot comfort meal for game day
- [Sweet Potato Veggie Burgers Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/sweet-potato-veggie-burgers): Gluten-free sweet potato & tofu veggie burgers with rosemary & maple
- [Grilled Eggplant & Pesto Sandwiches Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/grilled-eggplant-pesto-sandwiches): Grilled eggplant ciabatta sandwiches with arugula-walnut pesto

## Soups & Salads

- [Chickpea Miso Noodle Soup Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/chickpea-lemon-miso-noodle-soup): Vegan healing chickpea miso noodle soup with lemon broth - gluten-free
- [Roasted Cauliflower & Leek Soup Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/creamy-cauliflower-leek-soup): Vegan roasted cauliflower leek soup with cashew cream & miso
- [Roasted Sweet Potato & Cranberry Salad Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/roasted-sweet-potato-wheatberry-salad): Hearty fall wheat berry salad with sweet potatoes & cider dressing
- [Lemon-Walnut Quinoa & Chickpea Salad Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/lemon-walnut-quinoa-chickpea-salad): Healthy quinoa chickpea salad with zesty lemon-walnut dressing
- [Brussels Sprout & Sunchoke Salad Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/brussels-sprout-sunchoke-salad): Warm winter salad with pan-fried sunchokes & shaved brussels sprouts

## Breakfast & Brunch

- [Whole Wheat Vegan Waffles Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/wheat-vegan-waffles): Freezer-friendly whole wheat vegan waffles for easy weekday breakfast
- [Blueberry Rooibos Tea Smoothie Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/blueberry-rooibos-tea-smoothie): Antioxidant-loaded blueberry rooibos tea smoothie for healthy breakfast

## Appetizers & Snacks

- [Mini Tomato and Herb Bruschettas Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/mini-bruschettas): Vegan tomato & herb bruschetta appetizer ready in under 30 minutes
- [Sweet Curry Brown Sugar Popcorn Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/sweet-curry-popcorn): Vegan sweet curry popcorn with brown sugar - quick party snack
- [Sweet Curried Almonds](https://www.loveandlemons.com/sweet-curried-almonds): Sweet curry-spiced roasted almonds - Equal Exchange Mother's Day gift

## Desserts & Drinks

- [Pistachio Cranberry Cookies Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/pistachio-cranberry-cookies): Vegan pistachio cranberry oat cookies adapted from Amy Chaplin cookbook
- [Berries & Coconut Cream Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/berries-coconut-cream): Simple vegan summer dessert with fresh berries & coconut cream
- [Minty Pomegranate Spritzer Recipe](https://www.loveandlemons.com/minty-pomegranate-spritzer): Festive pomegranate vodka cocktail with prosecco & mint simple syrup
